text:
maya: heads up — staging publish failed provenance check for image gcr.io/redwood/staging/api:build-20260319-42
deploy-bot: publish rejected: manifest annotation mismatch (provenance.ttl expired)
sam: wait, how did TTL expire? that build was from ~15m ago
maya: looks like build server clock was skewed, attestation timestamp older than manifest by ~2h
roshan: we need a decision: retag+republish or rollback staging? @_ops-jen
ops-jen: prefer retag+republish with fresh attestation from CI. rollback would tear down the canary chain
maya: CI can re-run cosign attestation, but we should pin the resulting digest in release notes and avoid auto-promote
sam: +1. proposed plan:
  1) cancel current staging promote
  2) trigger CI re-sign: `ci/release sign-artifact --build-id 20260319-42`
  3) republish manifest with new attestation and new tag `build-20260319-42-rt1`
  4) run quick smoke canary (5%), then widen if green
  5) update release notes & pin digest on the rollout
roshan: also request a 30m change window so mirrors and regional republishers don't collide
maya: queuing the CI job now
deploy-bot: publish job queued: job-id abc123, target=gcr (eu), retries=3, expected window=30m
ci-bot: cosign step started on runner r-17
ci-bot: cosign result: attestation created, timestamp=1777777700
maya: that timestamp is older than the manifest ts we saw (1777777760) — still wrong
ops-jen: sounds like the CI runner clock is wrong / tz misconfig. re-run with NTP/chrony fixed
maya: re-run issued, environment var TZ and ntp synced
ci-bot: cosign result: attestation created, timestamp=1777777805
maya: republished as gcr.io/redwood/staging/api@sha256:deadbeefcafebabe..., tag=build-20260319-42-rt1
sam: quick smoke canary passed (latency/smoke ok)
maya: updated release notes: "staging publish retried due to attestation timestamp skew; image pinned to sha256:deadbeefcafebabe; tag build-20260319-42-rt1; no production promote yet"
roshan: decision: no rollback. promote to internal canary for 1h, monitor errors/latency/trace sampling
sam: will file follow-up to add a pre-publish clockcheck on CI and runner fleet (ENG-1723)
maya: thanks — adding note to the release ticket and notifying security for attestation audit :thumbsup:
